We’re excited to host basketball at the newly upgraded South Austin Recreation Center this upcoming season! Whether you’re looking to get back into the game, brush up on your skills, or just test out the court before signing up, this free play preview is the perfect time to drop in.

Come play a few open games, meet other players in the community, and experience the new venue firsthand.
